issues.where: the middle band of the lake, between the far shore and the near weed
issues.what: a cut-off copy of the lit cliff reflection floats in the middle of the water with a hard lower edge, like a second shoreline. In -a this band is dark blue reflective water with ripple rings
issues.fix: keep the cliff reflection against the far shore and let it fade into dark, rippled blue water toward the camera

issues.where: the foreground boulders on the left and right
issues.what: huge, clean, pale granite blocks with drawn-on stripes now frame the shot. -a has low, weathered grey limestone scree with lichen and moss, and a small rushing stream at bottom left that is gone in -b
issues.fix: go back to low, broken, weathered grey scree at the scale in -a, and bring back the stream with white water at bottom left

issues.what: smooth, glossy blue-grey pebbles with a cool CG sheen fill the lower half. -a has warm, wet, gritty gravel with flecks of orange mat, softened by shallow depth of field
issues.fix: replace them with small, rough, warm-lit wet gravel and orange mat debris, and soften the nearest stones out of focus

issues.where: the underwater weed and ledges in the lower two-thirds
issues.what: the weed is all rust-orange in fine tangled threads, with none of the golden-yellow and ochre strands of -a. The pale limestone ledges are flat blobs with hard edges that look stuck on. The rising bubble trails are gone
issues.fix: bring the weed back to a gold-yellow-red mix in thicker, combed strands, give the ledges rounded, textured, partly covered edges, and add the rising bubble columns

issues.where: the far shore under the cliffs
issues.what: the thick fog bank over the far water in -a has thinned to a light haze, so the cliff base reads hard and close
issues.fix: thicken the low mist along the far shore so it hides the cliff base the way it does in -a

issues.where: the orange mat across the shallows
issues.what: the mat is turned into saturated flame-like streaks. -a has terraced bands of orange and ochre mat broken by pale salt-crust flats
issues.fix: lower the saturation, lay the mat out in flat terraces, and bring back the pale crusted patches between them

issues.where: the herd on the shore and in the shallows
issues.what: the animals are dark brown and look unlit. In -a they are pale cream and catch the warm low light, so they read clearly against the gravel
issues.fix: make their coats pale cream and give them warm light from the left with a rim on the sunward side

issues.where: the three adults and the calf
issues.what: the coats are dark tan-brown with fur. -a has pale, bare, cream-pink skin that takes a warm glow from the low sun
issues.fix: lighten the animals to the pale cream of -a and put the warm low-sun highlight on their backs and necks

issues.where: the shallow water around the animals' legs and in the middle of the frame
issues.what: the gold strands of floating mat on the water are gone, and the leg reflections are smeared and blotchy
issues.fix: put back the scattered gold mat strands on the surface and make the leg reflections clean and broken by ripples

issues.where: the three animals at far left
issues.what: the bodies are dark brown, against the pale cream bodies in -a
issues.fix: make them pale cream like the animals in -a

issues.where: the lake surface in the middle distance
issues.what: the ripple rings in the middle of the lake are gone, and the mist lying on the water is thinner than in -a
issues.fix: add a few soft ripple rings and thicken the low mist on the water a little

issues.where: the foreground rocks and the gravel
issues.what: the light on them is flat and cool, with no warm side-light from the low sun at left
issues.fix: warm the sun-facing sides of the rocks and give them longer shadows to the right

issues.what: the cliffs and sky are slightly pinker and more salmon than the warm gold of -a
issues.fix: move the grade toward gold and away from pink
